title: ValueModel
description: Canonical Value Model (CVM) v1.0.0 — defines the full value proposition of a B2B product in a computable, structured form: variables, equations, value drivers, continuity profiles, key category metrics, and tier/module catalog. Part of The Value Project open standard. Schema: Apache-2.0 (https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0). Copyright 2026 The Value Project (https://github.com/The-Value-Project/value-models).

schema_version.description: Version of the ValueModel schema this instance conforms to. Must be '1.0.0'.

model_id.description: Stable unique identifier for this ValueModel instance. Used by CustomerVariables to reference the model. Example: 'vm_acme_sales_intelligence_v1'.

product_name.description: Human-readable name of the product or solution this value model describes.

product_description.description: Brief description of what the product does and the primary problem it solves.

variables.description: All variables used in value driver equations and dependencies. Each variable has a JavaScript-safe name used in equations, a display name for UI, a description explaining how to determine its value, a type, and a category.

name.description: JavaScript-safe identifier used in equations. Must match exactly when referenced in value_drivers[].variables_used[] and equations.

display_name.description: Human-readable label shown in UI and reports.

description.description: How to determine this variable's value for a specific customer. Should be sufficient for an LLM or analyst to estimate it from public sources or a discovery call.

type.description: Data type. Money = currency amount; Numeric = dimensionless count or rate; Percentage = expressed as a whole number (e.g., 30 means 30%, not 0.3).

category.description: Solution Variable: a property of the vendor's solution (e.g., accuracy rate). Improvement Claim: the improvement the solution delivers (e.g., % reduction in manual effort). Market Variable: a property of the customer's market context (e.g., average deal size). Customer Variable: a property of the specific customer (e.g., number of sales reps).

unit.description: Optional unit of measure for display purposes (e.g., 'hours/week', 'USD', '%').

default_value.description: Optional default or benchmark value used when no customer-specific estimate is available.

dependencies.description: Derived variable relationships. A dependency defines a variable whose value is computed from other variables via a JavaScript expression, rather than being estimated directly.

variable.description: Name of the dependent variable (must match a name in variables[]).

equation.description: JavaScript expression computing this variable from other variable names. All referenced names must exist in variables[].

value_drivers.description: Economic impact calculations. Each driver represents one distinct source of value the solution creates, expressed as a JavaScript equation that resolves to a currency amount.

name.description: Unique name for this value driver. Referenced by CustomerVariables.value_drivers[].name.

subcategory.description: Optional subcategory for finer grouping within category.

equation.description: JavaScript expression that evaluates to the annual economic impact of this driver in currency units. Must use only variable names declared in variables[].

description.description: Plain-language explanation of what this driver measures and why it creates value. Should be sufficient for a non-technical reader to understand.

variables_used.description: Explicit list of variable names used in the equation. Must be a subset of variables[].name.

continuity_profile.description: Declares whether this driver's value is realized once or recurs over time.

type.description: one_time: value is realized in a single period. recurring: value recurs annually, potentially with decay.

annual_decay_rate.description: For recurring drivers: fractional reduction in value per year due to diminishing returns, competitive response, etc. 0 = no decay; 0.1 = 10% reduction per year.

time_horizon_years.description: For recurring drivers: number of years over which to accumulate value in multi-year ROI calculations.

tiers_or_modules.description: Names of tiers or modules (from tiers_and_modules[]) that must be purchased to unlock this value driver. References the pricing-models repo's PricingModel.tiers_and_modules[] by name.

key_category_metric.description: The observable metric that should be tracked post-sale to verify this driver's value was actually realized. Separates the predicted impact (equation) from the measurable outcome.

key_category_metric_equation.description: JavaScript expression computing the key category metric from declared variables. Must use only variable names in variables[].

tiers_and_modules.description: Catalog of subscription tiers and add-on modules. Names here are referenced by value_drivers[].tiers_or_modules[] and correspond to tier/module names in the PricingModel schema (pricing-models repo).

name.description: Unique name for this tier or module. Must match the corresponding name in the PricingModel schema.

module.description: true if this is an add-on module; false if it is a subscription tier.

description.description: What capabilities this tier or module includes.

includes.description: Names of other tiers or modules included in this one. Allows tier hierarchy modeling (e.g., Enterprise includes Professional).
